definition: Derived exposure normalization; source counts and benchmark scores unchanged. Progress km is route_length * completion, not odometry. entries_per_progress_km is dominated by the checkpoint grid (each route is split into 20 parts of its own length), so it separates route mix and progress, not speed; below_100_percent is the field that carries the speed signal. Every record carries an `assistance` block; assistance labels for openpilot/original24 come from openpilot-24-infractions.csv (sha256 69eb46cc6654a6b7cb68a646cc7df8e45156827e4b234e209b0d5441d1a95bb8).

pooled_means_withheld.reason: OpenPilot's 24 historical routes include human resume assistance on 16 of them; the 26 expansion routes use a different upstream longitudinal setup. The two are never pooled into one mean. Use summaries.original24.openpilot, summaries.expansion26.openpilot and summaries.openpilot_unassisted24_estimate.

openpilot_unassisted24_estimate.note: Reconstruction behind README footnote ◆: the 16 assisted recordings are censored at the first human resume, the 8 unassisted ones are taken as recorded. Not a separate unassisted sweep, and not comparable route-for-route with summaries.original24.openpilot, which is the same 24 routes as actually recorded.

all50_protocol_note: Pooled recorded results. OpenPilot includes assistance in 16 historical recordings and a different upstream longitudinal setup in 26 expansion routes; not a homogeneous unassisted 50-route result. QwenDrive (added later) is a zero-shot run through the same Paddock tracker; its route 24333 entry is the valid rerun after a startup-guard fix, the crashed first attempt is excluded.
